svg.desc: A query is compared with four keys. Scores 2.0, 1.0 and 0.5 and a masked fourth key become softmax weights 0.63, 0.23, 0.14 and 0; the output is the weighted sum of the values.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attention is a soft dictionary lookup

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One query scores every key; softmax turns scores into weights; the output mixes the values.
